## 1.0.8 — 2026-08-05

### The queue tells the truth — and serves the project you're in
- **Active project first.** The processing queue serves the open project's
  jobs before any other project's, and the panel shows only the open
  project's numbers — everything else is one "+N queued for other projects"
  note. The "jobs remaining" headline can no longer undercount the queue.
- **Opening a project resumes its analysis.** Previously only the project
  auto-resumed at launch picked up its unfinished work; now every open does.
- **Previews beat the backlog.** Every preview sheet builds before any job
  waits on the GPU, so thumbnails land minutes after a copy even with a big
  transcription backlog; best-moment ranking drains once the GPU frees.

### Ingest honesty
- **The source drive has a name.** The ingest window title, a new clickable
  Source row, the source card, and the transfer summary all say which drive
  a transfer reads from (`H: — "A7IV_CARD"`).
- **True counts.** Timelapse frames count as ONE sequence in the Resolve and
  Metadata denominators (no more "placing 80 of 2400" against a real queue
  of ~250), and stale catalog rows for deleted files no longer hold the
  Metadata row short of green.
- **Fast re-checks again.** Re-inserting an already-transferred card no
  longer reads the whole card through the read-ahead — expected duplicates
  are predicted up front and skipped with a stat, not a read.
- **Corrupt stills are refused, not placed.** A content-free photo (e.g. a
  camera-recovery file of all zeros) fails the import with a clear reason in
  the summary instead of being guessed onto the timeline as a black still
  under an "Unknown Camera".

### Stability & housekeeping
- **Model loads can't poison each other.** Concurrent AI model loads
  (SigLIP/EasyOCR/Whisper/Qwen) are serialized — a startup race could
  previously leave the OCR detector with uninitialized weights.
- **Backup mirror scope.** Only live projects mirror into the client backup;
  archive drives keep their own on-drive catalogs.
- **Resolve: Timelapses bin** now nests inside Footage instead of its own
  root-level tree.
- **Graphics: Vertical 4K** (2160 × 3840) joins the shape picker.
- **Faster copies.** The copy read-ahead is fixed (it was serving 1 file in
  6), catalog writes left the copy thread, and the transfer summary says
  where its time went.
- **Whisper** no longer writes confident nonsense for non-speech audio.
- **Archive Manager**: pause, honest progress, reconcile, folder browsing,
  grid sort, and a right-click Reset analysis with its own dry run.
- **Colour Grade** opens on the timeline you have open, not the newest
  rough cut.
